services.desc: Destin Florida's Choctawhatchee Bay is located in the world's "Luckiest Fishing Village". Destin is not only known for great fishing but also the beautiful emerald green waters. Fishing in the Choctawhatchee Bay and Santa Rosa Sound is a good option for families with young children as well as experienced anglers. Destin Bay Fishing Trips will target mainly Speckled Sea Trout, Redfish and Spanish Mackerel. At the beginning of each year through Spring Break in Destin Florida we fish for Redfish, Sheephead, Pompano and Spanish Mackerel.
